name: Seed Junky Pre-Roll | Donut Peach
description:
Inspired by the legendary flat peaches of ancient China—once said to grant immortality to those lucky enough to taste them. The aroma is loud and unmistakable: sweet peach, with a hit of peach ring candy. The flavor rolls in with notes of caramelized peaches and a clean, smooth finish. The experience starts off fun and uplifting before easing you into a relaxed, mellow state.

Zkittlez x Animal Cookies BX2 IX
